properties.displayName: MAS - Manual attestation for Key Inventory and Discovery
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Implement a secure key management system for cloud environments, incorporating key inventory and discovery across infrastructure and workloads, with continuous monitoring and periodic reviews to ensure key protection and compliance. (Data-Security-53).

metadata.Description:
Key Inventory and Discovery
for more details - refer to Control statement
Key Inventory and Discovery
1. Automated Asset Discovery
- Implements comprehensive multi-cloud asset discovery and dependency mapping
2. Key Catalog
- Maintains a centralized inventory of all encryption keys, their locations, and associated cloud resources
- Tags keys with metadata including owner, purpose, and expiration date
3. Relationship Mapping
- Maps dependencies between keys and cloud resources, applications, and data stores
- Identifies potential security risks and compliance issues related to key usage
metadata.controlTitle: Implement a secure key management system for cloud environments, incorporating key inventory and discovery across infrastructure and workloads, with continuous monitoring and periodic reviews to ensure key protection and compliance.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
